# fixture: legacy_z_roundtrip
# A version-2 report, back when `Z` was the only in-region good glyph. It must
# still parse -- as in-region grade-1 die -- and marked_region() must recover
# row=2 col=4, so an old report remains valid input. Re-rendering it produces
# the version-3 alphabet (`A` for an in-region grade-1 die), so this fixture
# deliberately does NOT round-trip byte for byte; see marked_roundtrip.txt for
# the v3 spelling of the same result.
# expect: row=2 col=4 good=57 defect=36 overhang=0
# yield_max 2  region=row2,col4
# good=57 defect=36 overhang=0 sites=93 yield=61.3%
# in-region: Z=good *=defect -=overhang   outside: 1=good X=defect .=absent
